cross_product_finding: Same access-model mismatch as createindex.json: Prerequisites keys the privilege off 'cluster access credential type' (Basic -> Write, Advanced -> Query Index), not privilege:query-manage-index. Also, like createindex.md, this page's WITH-clause 'nodes' option cites 'Couchbase Server versions 7.6.0 and 7.6.1' vs '7.6.2 and later' as a behavior gate and links to a server/ Rebalance page - version-shaped content on a page whose product is framed as version-less. Not minting a version concept for this per instructions; flagging only. Separately, the index-state enum (scheduled for creation/deferred/building/pending/online/offline/abridged) is reused as-is here, consistent with the registry's note that this enum is likely still valid on Capella since it describes the underlying GSI engine, not the deployment model.
